nom: Personal Day Trust Me on This Hypochlorous Acid Gel

avis.texte: I love hypochlorous acid for dabbing on blemishes and scrapes. Unfortunately the packaging on this particular brand is faulty. The pump stopped working after two uses, and I know it isn't simply clogged because if I try and pump it as hard as possible I can feel air come out. It seems that the pump design and the consistency of the product are incompatible, and there is no way to open the bottle to bypass the pump. I'm bitter about wasting my money on this product when there are so many other solid hypochlorous options on the market, even at big-box stores now. Learn from my mistake -- try a different brand!
Works wonderfully, my skin has never felt more healthy and clean. I don't have anymore breakouts. I use this with the toner as well

avis.titre: Must for your sensitive, problem skin kit.
avis.texte: I am 46 with super sensitive acne, rosacea, a rash prone skin. This is a must have for your emergency spot kit for when you have a big pimple, rosacea plaque, or eczema type patch that you want to go away overnight. I can use this along with the new Vani watery pump lotion and the Paula salicylic spray meant for backs on my face when I want to clear acne from my skin quickly and gracefully ASAP.. IKYK. Expensive, but must keep on hand. Probably goes bad in 3 mos from what I read about HA? Check on it.

This gel saves my skin all the time. I have MCAS and suffer from 7 different chemical allergies (ingredients that are in so many products!) so I get rashes several times a week. This stuff helps my skin stay calmer and heal quickly. It's the best over all the other products I've tried plus I love the gel formula.
I use this on my makeup brushes, pillow cases, after workouts, and before bed. It really prevents bacteria that can so easily create acne on my very sensitive, porous skin. Thank you Lili!

avis.titre: Lightweight & Absorbing, But a Tad Drying
avis.texte: I've been using the Hypochlorous Acid Gel in conjunction with the spray & have found the two products to be very effective at reducing redness & healing my breakout spots quickly. I have some stubborn acne around my mouth & chin, & those areas have shown some improvement after just a few days of using the products. The only thing I noticed is that the areas where my breakouts were healing have been getting a bit dry which can make applying makeup a little difficult. I anticipate that my skin just needs a little more time to adjust to the formula, & then the dryness will subside. The photos show a difference in my skin after just a few days of using the spray morning & night & using the gel at night after cleansing. I definitely plan to repurchase this!
really love the product overall, the gel works great to calm and remove and new coming imperfections. the only problem is the "sprayer" gets stuck when i want to use it
Grateful for this product. A dab over a breakout seals the "wound" so I can apply powder foundation safely on top without interfering with healing. PLEASE MAKE A TRAVEL SIZE!!

I love how this product helps my open pimples heal faster and is protecting me from gaining more in the same area. I have acne prone skin and when I pick at my face I feel a little more at ease with this acid gel to use after. Definitely recommend.

In my quiet office, the spray version always made people turn to look. This is more discrete and does not feel heavy - it's a gel but it's very very light. Really great!! Also, it's lasting a LONG time. I've been using it multiple times a day almost every day for almost a month now, and it hasn't run out.
Works wonders! Has become a trusted part of my daily skin care routine

avis.titre: Love the gel for harder to reach areas!
avis.texte: I love the spray and gel combo! I use the spray when Im out and the gel at home. Dont stop making this!

This container and pump may be the worst thing I've ever tried to use. The first time I used it, the pump worked fine. A week later I went to use it again and nothing came out. I had to meticulously clean it and it finally kind of gave me some product. Months into this now and I have a container that's essentially full that I've used maybe 6 times and now it no longer gives me anything no matter how much I try to clean it out.

avis.titre: Works great and I'm very impressed!!
avis.texte: I have a dry scaly spot on my forehead from a breakout and it would not go away no matter if I kept it dry or hydrated, trying all kind of different products. This stuff started improving the acne scar after the first use. I love it and will be stocking up next time it goes on sale.

I am literally only one week in and this has changed my skin. I'm not even being dramatic. At 37, I've struggled my entire adult life with acne and bumps/texture all over my forehead, temples, and general t-zone. Within one week, these are all almost completely gone and my face is super soft. I cannot tell you what a RELIEF this is!! Where has this been for the last 20 years?!

avis.titre: Amazing for post extractions and hormonal breakouts!!!
avis.texte: I got this product during the 21 days of beauty sale, I decided to give it a go because ive been wanting to try this brand and it was 50% off. I dermaplane and do blackhead extractions on myself bi weekly (safely and I've done ample research). I always use the good molecules hypochlorus acid spray and love that and this seemed to be an adjacent product. Ive been using it on my breakouts and problem areas almost daily since I got it and WOW!! It is like a magic eraser for my face. I have VERY sensitive skin and eczema and this did not irritate my skin whatsoever. It felt so amazing after extractions and soothed the redness around my blemishes. I also used it to soothe a sunburn on my cheeks and it worked well for that as well! Highly recommend this product! I read some reviews saying there were issues with the packaging, I personally did not have any issues with the packaging on the product I bought. I feel sad for those who had a bad experience with this product but everyone's skin is different!

I'm in my early 30s and starting to experience more small uneven textured bumps that not even exfolation was helping. I bonded with an Ulta worker about it and she swore by this. I figured I'd give it a go since I've tried so many other products to no avail and this was in my price point. YALL. When I tell you I noticed a difference within 2 days, WITHOUT any purging!! I have sensitive skin and have experienced severe eczema that occasionally flares up with some new products, but I've been using this for about 2 weeks without any issue. My skin looks and feels night and day compared to 2 weeks ago. My forehead now has that glassy shine instead of looking dull and bumpy. This will absolutely stay in my essentials line up so long as the formula stays the same!

I purchased two from the Personal Day website. One was for me and the other was for a family member. First, the pumps were not working well to dispense the product, I'd have to pump a few times to get a normal amount of product out. After less than a month of use, I noticed mold on the nozzle of both bottles.

avis.titre: Triggered a rosacea flare up and smells AWFUL
avis.texte: This triggered a rosacea flareup for me. I used it and then about 20 minutes later, my cheeks were bright red and hot and didn't go back down until the next morning. So if you have sensitive skin or rosacea, you might want to pass. The other thing is that it smells TERRIBLE. It smells exactly like pool chemicals (because it actually is an industrial disinfectant). The smell does fade a few minutes after you put it on but wow, it is very strong and unpleasant right out of the bottle.
This is my FAVE and has cleared my skin, but after multiple purchases the bottle breaks so easy! It solidifies inside and I cant get it out!

I love this stuff. I've been using hypochlorous acid spray and love that but this stuff is liquid gold. It's so soothing and calms my breakouts and redness quickly. I put it on and night and smaller breakouts look significantly better the next day. The gel just feels like it works where you need it.

I like the product itself; it's soothing on breakouts, especially after picking or popping. However, the bottle is a nightmare, at least for me. It stopped dispensing product after not very many uses, and I emailed Personal Day for assistance. They told me the pump was probably clogged and to try to clean it out. That worked once, but now the bottle is clogged again and won't dispense product no matter how much I try to clean out the dispenser and rinse it under warm water. You can't take the whole top off, either (at least not that I can figure out), so now it's almost impossible to even access the product, of which I have probably 75% left. I won't be buying this again unless they can figure out a way to package it that fixes this issue.
This is a great serum for post-picking your acne! It cuts the healing time way down

This product changed my skin overnight. I have tried so many products, masques etc nothing has helped with the tiny bumps on my forehead. This product specifically has helped clear my skin drastically when absolutely nothing else has. I will now be trying all of the proucts from this line.

avis.titre: Love but packaging NEEDS to change
avis.texte: This was working so well for me for a couple weeks, when I packed it in my luggage for a flight. The pump immediately stopped working, and the top doesn't screw off, so it's impossible to get the product out. It's a shame, because now most of the bottle is just wasted. I want to buy another but annoying that you risk just wasting money over a finicky bottle I guess don't bring this on planes!

Queen Lily 🙂ŒðŸ¼ this stuff is the BEST hypochlorous acid on the market and you should in fact trust me on this! I have somewhat sensitive skin and I use this anytime I have a blemish or red area on my face/neck and the redness disappears. It's like magic in a bottle. IMO the gel consistency is much more effective then the liquid spray and I can target red areas more precisely. Love love love this product.

I have been using the gel alongside the acne treatment toner. I have been using both products 2x a day for about a week now. I have already started seeing a difference in my acne marks. When I purchased this product, I had a cluster on the side of my chin that would not go away--they either kept refilling or the marks just stayed super red. Since using the gel, along with the toner, the cluster of acne have finally healed and the spots have faded significantly. You can still see them but they look WAY better than they did and I don't feel self conscious about them anymore. This product does not seem to be drying out my face which makes me so happy since this product seems to really work! I will definitely continue to use and purchase more in the future.
love the feeling of this and it is clearly helping my skin! i've tried both this and the spray and i'm going to stick with this gel because it feels more impactful
It feels great on my skin, and I love that it's a gel rather than a spray.

For my acne prone, sensitive skin, this does the tricking at calming my redness and irritation from my breakouts and my acne treatments! Most brands have this acid combo in a spray, but I really like using the gel because I'm not wasting product spraying it in the air. One bottle lasts a long time too!
This product says best when used after picking. And I agree. It does seem to help soothe the skin and keep the spot you picked from getting worse. Almost like it starts to just go away
This stuff is really amazing and I love that it is in a serum/light gel form! It makes it feel like it stays on throughout the day helping keep the acne bacteria at bay.
This stuff is amazing! It has fully transformed my skin and I am so grateful!

I like the product itself, I think it works. However the packaging is so poorly designed. I've been using this product for maybe 2 weeks and the pump is completely clogged- I tried maybe 20 pumps today and nothing came out. Please redesign!

I have recently been diagnosed with psoriasis, and was gifted this product. I was planning to give to a family member with acne, especially since most skin care creates issues for me. But I took a picture of ingredients and plugged into AI and ask if it would work for psoriasis and it said it could be good… so I slapped in on my very painful itchy hands and went to bed. The next morning I could see a difference already so I put more on and took a photo so I could measure progress. By the end of the day my hand is well on a path toward healing and no longer itchy. I am blown away. I have tried 4-5 different prescriptions and multiple over the counter products and none of them did anything on this spot!! Photos attached are SAME DAY. I'm so thrilled and can't wait to hopefully continue the healing in other spots now!!
I ordered every product from their Black Friday sale and have been very impressed so far. I use this every day and I definitely feel like it's helping keep my hormonal acne at bay.
I love the product and has worked great for my skin, but the pump barely works and if it does work nothing really comes out. I have to take the pump off and pour into hands.

Lightweight gel that helps reduce redness and inflammation. It makes my skin feel clean but also a little dry, though not a big deal for me because I always apply Personal Day moisturizer after and my face feels so smooth!

Great until pump stops pumping. I've had to shake it and pump it upside down to get it to give me more product but definitely maybe needs a different kind of pump or application modality because it does feel like it's really hard to use the full product and get your moneys worth.

I bought a subscription of this for my daughter who loves it but the gel has solidified in the container of her first delivery and she can't get anymore out of the container :( any advice on how to de-solidify would be appreciated!
Love this stuff. Its liquid gold. Cleared up my face after only a few weeks.

I really love this product, it has been great for my sensitive and acne prone skin. The only downside is the packaging. The pump often gets clogged and I try cleaning it out but the product just continues to dry in there. Hope they change that but otherwise, would recommend!
This product helps control my hormonal acne and has been such a confidence booster. It makes my skin so soft and less red and calms down any irritations. 10/10 recommend!

avis.titre: Hands down the best at calming my inflammation
avis.texte: This calmed the inflammation from acne from the first try. I quickly noticed everything calming down and my face was less painful.

hormonal acne has ruled my life up until i started using personal day! my redness and active breakouts are pretty much gone and i only get some small pimples around my period, but even that is a huge improvement from what i struggled with before. it is so difficult to find skincare products that don't irritate my skin or break me out, but personal day's formulation is just what i needed! will be purchasing other products soon :-) i would love to see a retinol or toner in the future!
This product is a life saver as i'm an avid face picker. I bought some for my brother and he also loves it and uses it daily!
I bought this because I have been having really bad hormonal, breakouts on my face and neck. I put this gel on my neck every morning and every evening and I have not had a breakout in over one month.
Especially in blemishes in its first phase. A bump. It also helped an area of my face that was a little "sandy". I use the spray too.

I struggle with skin picking and decided to try this. It has been amazing in calming my skin and helping it heal. The reason for 4 stars is because I am a bit frustrated with the bottle design- I am almost out and would like to take the top off to get to the remaining product, but the top doesn't seem to come off. A different or altered bottle design that allows that would be a great improvement!

avis.titre: < 3 the formula, packaging may need some work
avis.texte: I love the product so far, it's very refreshing/cooling when applied and seems to soothe redness and help my skin to heal quicker which I adore - I find myself using it 2-3 times a day! My main issue is that the pump stopped working after about a week, so I have to completely screw off the cap and dump the product out to use it which is cumbersome and inefficient. I'm not sure if this is a one-off, but I'll let y'all know when I buy again 😌

I use this product in the morning. It keeps my skin feeling hydrated and clean for most of the day. I was unsure if I'd like this product as first; however, after trying it and using it everyday, I now have it as a permanent product in my everyday skincare routine!

I can't say enough good things about this line - especially this gel. It keeps my skin moisturized while clearing it. Other acne/redness eliminators typically dry me to the bone. It's super gentle but i've been slathering it on and my blotchiness and breakouts are down by about 80% so far (I am using the full kit so salicylic acid as well).
This product is amazing! I've been struggling with hormonal imbalanced related breakouts and this really helps manage them
I bought this product because I've been getting more hormonal acne flare ups than usual. Since I started using this consistently (2x a day) my face is the clearest it has been in a long time.
Love this product. My only complain is I have about half the bottle left and pump stopped working I have to open the whole thing every time 👎
Great product. I am an avid outdoors woman and have endless scrapes on my legs. This is a great product to make sure they all heal quickly.

I am a person without a skincare routine, but when I saw an ad for this it caught my eye. Nothing has EVER helped my skin so much, and I've tried all kinds of things for years!! My skin has never looked healthier. The gel is cool and comforting & I will be buying more! You have got to check this out!!

I've never used something like this but I do like how it calms my skin immediately. I think it's good if you're a skin picker and popper like myself lol I like to put this on in combo with the acne treatment

I love this stuff because it doesn't sting or burn my face when I have acne. So many products that I use sting so badly on broken skin and this never does! And it helps the inflammation go away faster on acne

I have been using the Personal Day hypochlorous acid gel and moisturizer for just a couple of days and already see a huge difference in my skin. My complexion is more even, clear, and soft than it has been in forever. I dabbed this gel on a few spots that were in the process of clearing and they're almost completely gone after three days. I agree with whomever said that this brand needs more buzz around it- the products are high quality!

I use this every morning and I have definitely seen a change in the consistency of my skin. They are mostly all good skin days now, and the odd spot I do get is small and goes away quickly. I can't wait to get the mist as well.
Amazing product, started working right away to clear up my acne flare.
I was surprised to see how well this promotes skin healing! I would definitely recommend.

This brand needs more recognition!! This gel has gotten rid of some stubborn dark spot on my face, as well as destroying pimples. I have pretty clear skin, but when I get a pimple sometimes they're hard to get to surface. This stuff a few times a day and the pimple surfaces, is popped, and healed in 24-48 hours. It also bring all the gunk to the surface so you don't pop it, and the next day have another white head from more gunk left in that same pimple. Acne girls… this brand really is for you!
My face heals so much faster, and I see less evidence of scarring and pigmentation after using it. I plan to keep this in my skin regimen no matter what other products I use!
I've found using this gel on current acne and healing scars really speeds up the process. I dab it on morning and evening and each next day, is a little better!
I used this as a spot treatment on a new breakout. I couldn't believe how quickly it dried up.

I've been using the Trust Me on This Hypochlorous Acid Gel for almost two months, and it has completely changed my skin. I struggle with acne and sensitivity, and since adding this into my routine, my skin hardly breaks out anymore. I actually bought the whole skincare line, but the gel is hands-down my favorite. It made the biggest difference in calming inflammation and healing breakouts faster. It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and never leaves my skin feeling sticky or greasy. Just clean, calm, and refreshed. If you're dealing with breakouts or skin that gets easily irritated, this is 100% worth trying. It's become my go-to for keeping my skin clear and balanced.

After using the Personal Day products, my acne has calmed down significantly. I no longer have large zits pop up, if anything they're super mild and not often at all! When they do happen, I use the gel and they're gone the next morning! Absolutely amazing, completely saved me from constantly drying my face out with Panoxyl and benzoyl peroxide cream.

avis.titre: I trusted it, and it delivered
avis.texte: I looooove this product. Somehow, my face instantly feels less puffy every time I use it. And whenever I get one of those painful pimples, it really helps soothe and calm it down. Total game-changer in my routine!

If you have any skin problems then you need this in your routine! I can put this on a breakout or patch of eczema and it literally begins healing within a day! I was so hesitant before purchasing since I've tried every product under the sun but this exceeded my expectations!

I am absolutely loving this gel! I apply it to places in my face that tend to stay the most oily. I put it right around my nose and on my chin. I also put it on the back of my neck because I break out from the oil of my hair. This gel has cleared everything up and kept it clear! It has helped give me the confidence to not wear foundation everyday to cover up break outs. Thank you personal day!
Iʻm trying to reform my picking habit, but in the meantime, this gel has felt really soothing on irritated skin

I got this in the gel form so I mostly use it in the morning when I first wake up or if I've just finished cleaning my apartment and it's always super refreshing and makes my skin feel instantly fresh. Definitely want to get the spray next.
This product has been so good for my skin! Especially with eczema it's been a game changer
I use this on my face & body and I truly love it. Would recommend for traveling & after workouts :)

I absolutely love this hypochlorous acid gel!! I've never used a product like this so I'm so glad Personal Day introduced it to my routine! It's lightweight, non greasy, and absorbs quickly into my skin. I've been using it as a spot treatment for my acne and it really helps to calm redness and irritation! It's also great for overall skin balance, leaving my skin feeling super hydrated and calm. This gel has been a lifesaver so I highly recommend it to anyone who has sensitive or acne-prone skin!
